scope: Manual semantic review of the same fourteen-case task used for Gemma. Not blinded, whole-page extraction or population accuracy. Eleven literal-valid answers include abstention and semantic failures. No answer was repaired or partially promoted.

cases.review: Separates chairman and CEO and attaches February 2014 only to CEO, but invents the contiguous quote Satya Nadella is Chief Executive Officer by removing intervening words. The unchanged validator rejects the whole answer; semantic improvement does not repair the citation.
Retains the exact compound title, named subject, organization and supporting sentence; leaves time unknown. Supported source mention, not donor identity or publisher-truth verification.
Abstains on unbound flat name/title blocks. This respects the supplied evidence limit; it is not recovery of the two real roles. Card structure is absent from the model input.

Recovers the supported Dave Duffield role-before-name mention with exact quote and no date. Does not turn praise about others into titles or my son into an alias. The compound source wording remains unnormalized.

Quotes are literal and CEO time stays unknown instead of borrowing the founding date. However several quotes omit the named subject or organization; founder is a nonliteral normalization of founded. Also emits our board of directors as an organization without issuer identity. Reject the whole answer, including useful proposed relationships.

Avoids Gemma's fabricated family organization and retains plausible employment/founding/fraternity mentions. Still joins Theodore Ray Reviglio and Richard John Reviglio across parenthetical nicknames, violating exact source-name form. Woodhead's surname/name-form meaning is not classified by this schema. Reject the whole answer; no identity merge or partial salvage.
Keeps the Q/R names, organizations and CEO/engineer roles separate, with complete cited sentences. No employee promotion or identity merge.
Preserves not in the quotation and denied polarity. No spurious empty alias.

Correct denied label, but the quote omits That statement is false and cites only the positive sentence. Literal validation cannot enforce sufficient context; the cited claim is not semantically acceptable despite the correct polarity label.
Correct hypothetical label and retains were, but drops the opening If and consequence from the quotation. Conditional context is narrowed; do not present the quote as a self-contained asserted role.
Preserves the explicit from 2010 to 2015 wording and its role binding without inventing day-level precision.
Leaves role time unknown despite the page-modification date in a different entry.

Board role is retained, but the second role is employer rather than the reported SALES occupation. This is a literal string with the wrong semantic function. It does not promote an employee to executive, but it fails faithful role extraction.
Returns no proposals for the embedded instruction. One control does not establish general injection resistance.
